description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within a dataset, likely representing the types of queries or tasks present. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different category. The “chat” category is represented by a pink slice and comprises approximately 41.2% of the total. A blue slice represents “math” at roughly 21.9%, followed by a light green slice for “tooluse” at 11.6%. The “multi turn chat” category is shown as a yellow slice, accounting for approximately 9.0%, while “code” is represented by an orange slice at 9.0%. Finally, “instruction follow” is depicted as a purple slice, making up about 6.9% of the chart. A legend is provided in the upper left corner, associating colors with category labels. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending by proportion, starting with “chat” and ending with “instruction follow”.
